race.comment: CRUIZINGTHESTARS (1) tough ask in The Kosciuszko second up with a tiring eighth over 1200m at this track on the soft (6) surface. Strong winner at the trip and can bounce back in this easier contest with Keatings' claim from the rails draw. I AM ADONIS (6) jumped quickly into BM78 class second up with a tenacious on pace fifth over 1200m at Rosehill. Lone win came at this trip and has the right profile to take this out. SIRAGUSA (10) comes here deep into the prep after giving the progressive Unhinged 5kg last start when tenth over 1400m at Rosehill in BM72 class. Tongue-tie goes on and can bounce back quickly with the claim. HELLENIC BELLE (11) talented filly who wound up strongly first up with J Mac aboard with a narrow second over 1100m at Rosehill. Second up winner ready for this trip.
